heroTitle: Cost-free daily habits that change your mind and your body. That's it.
heroSubtitle: No paid tiers. No sign-up walls. No program to buy. Just what we've learned, shared plainly.
whyHeading: We've lived it, studied it, and now we're sharing it.
whyParagraph1: Every habit on this site has been tested somewhere real — in our own training, our own kitchens, our own hard days. We've paired that lived experience with continued education in exercise science, nutrition, supplementation, mental health, and immune wellness, and distilled it down to the habits that actually move the needle.
whyParagraph2: We didn't build this to sell you something. Real change doesn't come from a purchase — it comes from a decision, repeated daily, until it becomes who you are. Our job is just to make sure you're never short on good information to build that decision around.
freeHeading: No sign-up. No paywall. No catch.
freeParagraph: Nothing on Change Mind, Change Body is gated behind an email address, a subscription, or a program purchase. We're not building a funnel — we're building a resource. Read what's useful, take what applies to your life, and come back whenever you need the next habit.
pillarsHeading: Everything we share fits into one of these.
closingHeading: Change your mind. Change your body. Change everything that comes after.
closingParagraph: You don't need a program to start. You need one habit, done today, and then again tomorrow. Pick a pillar above and start there.
